question.prompt: An urn is filled with coins and beads, all of which are either silver or gold. Twenty percent of the objects in the urn are beads. Forty percent of the coins in the urn are silver. What percent of the objects in the urn are gold coins?

solutions.explanation:
Since \(20\%\) of the objects are beads, the remaining \(80\%\) are coins. Of those coins, \(40\%\) are silver, so \(60\%\) are gold.

The \(60\%\) refers to the coins, which make up only \(80\%\) of all objects. Therefore the proportion of all objects that are gold coins is
\[
0.80\cdot0.60=0.48=48\%.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{48\%}\), choice B.
solutions.title: Find a percentage of a percentage
